chunks: With this chain, from al-Hasan, from Abi Abdillah al-Mu'min, from Ibn Muskan, from Abi Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

Safeguard your wealth and your chaste organs (fertility/modesty) with the recitation of Surah al-Nur, and safeguard your women with it. He said: 'Whoever recites it regularly every day or every night, none from his family will commit adultery (or fall into sin) ever until he dies. When he dies, seventy thousand angels will accompany him to his grave, all of them supplicating and seeking forgiveness for him until he is placed in his grave.'
ai.seo_question: What are the spiritual rewards and protections associated with reciting Surah al-Nur according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In Shaykh al-Saduq’s *Thawab al-Amal*, this hadith highlights the protective efficacy of Surah al-Nur, linking its recitation to the preservation of wealth, chastity, and family modesty. It further promises a unique eschatological honor: seventy thousand angels accompany the consistent reciter to the grave, continuously invoking forgiveness until burial. This reflects the Shia emphasis on the intercessory power of Quranic recitation in safeguarding the household from sin.

en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 1. From the previous chain from al-Hassan from Abi Abdillah al-Mu’min from Ibn Muskan from Abi Abdillah (a.s.) who said: “

Safeguard your wealth, life and women with recitation of Surah Nur. One who recites it regularly everyday or every night none from his family will fall into trouble till he or she dies. When he dies 70000 angels would accompany his bier upto the grave and all those angels would keep praying for him and seeking forgiveness for him till the reciter is laid down in the grave.”
